1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.OctahedralNetFaces
2 
3 /-! The eight constructed maps satisfy the original-facet rigidity and hinge obligations. -/
4 
5 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
6 
7 open OctahedralTriangles OctahedralNet
8 
9 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {graph : P.SixVertexGraph}
10 variable {small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
11   (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4} {source : Fin 6} {slit : Fin 4}
12 variable (net : graph.Development small_faces source slit)
13 
14 /-- The actual affine map at a fan or petal position of the constructed net. -/
15 def place (index : FaceIndex) : Space →ᵃ[ℝ] Plane := if index.1 then net.petal index.2 else net.fan.place index.2
16 
17 /-- Every indexed map is rigid on its whole original carrier facet. -/
18 theorem rigid_netFace (index : FaceIndex) :
19     ∀ x ∈ (graph.netFace small_faces source slit index).val,
20       ∀ y ∈ (graph.netFace small_faces source slit index).val,
21         dist (net.place index x) (net.place index y) = dist x y := by
22   obtain ⟨petal, i⟩ := index
23   cases petal
24   · exact net.fan.rigid i
25   · exact net.petal_rigid i
26 
27 variable (octahedral : graph.kind = .octahedron)
28 
29 include octahedral in
30 /-- The prescribed seven hinges agree on the entire intersections of their original facets. -/
31 theorem joined_netFace (x y : FaceIndex) (adjacent : hinges.Adj x y) :
32     ∀ p ∈ (graph.netFace small_faces source slit x).val ∩ (graph.netFace small_faces source slit y).val,
33       net.place x p = net.place y p := by
34   have fan_joined (i : Fin 3) :
35       ∀ p ∈ (graph.netFace small_faces source slit (false, i.castSucc)).val ∩
36         (graph.netFace small_faces source slit (false, i.succ)).val,
37           net.place (false, i.castSucc) p = net.place (false, i.succ) p := by
38     rw [graph.netFace_intersection_pair small_faces octahedral source slit _ _ _ _ (fan_common_vertices source slit i)]
39     exact net.fan.joined i
40   have petal_joined (i : Fin 4) :
41       ∀ p ∈ (graph.netFace small_faces source slit (false, i)).val ∩
42         (graph.netFace small_faces source slit (true, i)).val,
43           net.place (false, i) p = net.place (true, i) p := by
44     rw [graph.netFace_intersection_pair small_faces octahedral source slit _ _ _ _ (petal_common_vertices source slit i)]
45     exact net.petal_joined i
46   rcases hinge_cases x y adjacent with ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩
47   · exact fan_joined i
48   · intro p hp
49     exact (fan_joined i p ⟨hp.2, hp.1⟩).symm
50   · exact petal_joined i
51   · intro p hp
52     exact (petal_joined i p ⟨hp.2, hp.1⟩).symm
53 
54 include octahedral in
55 /-- Only the twelve nonattached mixed pairs and six petal pairs remain to prove nonoverlap. -/
56 theorem nonoverlap_of_remaining_pairs
57     (mixed : ∀ i j : Fin 4, i ≠ j →
58       Disjoint (interior (net.fan.place i '' graph.triangle (fanTriangle (opposite source) (slit + i))))
59         (interior (net.petal j '' graph.triangle (fanTriangle source (slit + j)))))
60     (petals : ∀ i j : Fin 4, i ≠ j →
61       Disjoint (interior (net.petal i '' graph.triangle (fanTriangle source (slit + i))))
62         (interior (net.petal j '' graph.triangle (fanTriangle source (slit + j))))) :
63     ∀ x y : FaceIndex, x ≠ y →
64       Disjoint (interior (net.place x '' (graph.netFace small_faces source slit x).val))
65         (interior (net.place y '' (graph.netFace small_faces source slit y).val)) := by
66   rintro ⟨left, i⟩ ⟨right, j⟩ different
67   rw [graph.netFace_eq_triangle small_faces octahedral, graph.netFace_eq_triangle small_faces octahedral]
68   cases left <;> cases right
69   · exact net.fan.nonoverlap i j (fun same => different (Prod.ext rfl same))
70   · by_cases same : i = j
71     · subst j
72       exact net.attached_pair_nonoverlap i
73     · exact mixed i j same
74   · by_cases same : j = i
75     · subst j
76       exact (net.attached_pair_nonoverlap i).symm
77     · exact (mixed j i same).symm
78   · exact petals i j (fun same => different (Prod.ext rfl same))
79 
80 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph.Development
